admission.justification: Call-local canonical admission prevents one reader operation contaminating another with wrong code or memory roots.

conditions: The product resolves and admits the canonical task and contract pair.
exclusions: Binding does not prohibit another valid admitted leaf context.
Absent task_context uses configured repository roots.
statement: context_packet and read_ar_files admit per-call canonical task scope without caller-selected roots: an enclosed leaf uses its exact canonical enclosure; a granted direct leaf uses its canonical leaf and current readable grant with the exact master series contract. A launch binding is not a second read scope, and absent task_context keeps configured repository roots.
